components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for the primary call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0d9488; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: calc(0.75rem - 2px); transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0a7c71; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview: This system is built for speed and reliability. It eschews generic SaaS decorations (like heavy glassmorphism and cluttered metric cards) in favor of clear, functional utility.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved for state and semantics. Do not use background gradients or decorative color washes.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (like hover, active, or dropdown menus). Avoid diffuse ambient shadows.

dos: Do rely on structural borders for layout division.
Do use the established semantic seat colors exclusively for seat mapping.
Do ensure interactive elements feel minimal and flush.
donts: Don't use overly complex, generic SaaS-heavy templates.
Don't use cluttered metrics that distract from the core booking flow.
